attributes.long_name: GEDI L2B total canopy cover, cell median
attributes.definition: GEDI L2B cover: 'Total canopy cover, defined as the percent of the ground covered by the vertical projection of canopy material' (GEDI L2B V3 product data dictionary); valid range 0-1, so stored as a fraction despite the word 'percent'.
attributes.support: ~25 m lidar footprints in forest blocks inside the cell
attributes.comment: No CF standard name exists for this quantity (CF standard name table v95).
attributes.source: GEDI L2B V003 doi:10.5067/GEDI/GEDI02_B.003, subset by NASA Harmony
